verdict.summary: Candidate and pinned instruction hashes match; inspected captured 100-test success. Queue transactions and execution gates are preserved. However, submit trusts mutable context.pipeline['policy_sha256']; RegistrationContext.revalidate compares freshly loaded policy against context.policy, not context.pipeline. Changing only context.pipeline['policy_sha256'] to another valid digest therefore admits a run with a false private pipeline policy binding, and validate_queued never checks that field against trusted saved metadata. Derive configuration from revalidated policy['_pipeline_config'] or explicitly compare context.pipeline with the fresh loader result, and add a mutation regression. Execution/resource/workspace activation remains outside this bounded review.
